access__revoke_body: The address can no longer sign up. An existing account is not affected.
admin__backup_body: Each code works once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now: store them somewhere safe.
admin__code_invalid: That code is wrong or has expired.
admin__code_too_many: Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new one.
admin__enrol_body: The admin needs a second step: a code from an authenticator app. Set it up once; every admin sign-in asks for it.
admin__enrol_scan_body: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the code it shows.
admin__sign_in_body: Sign in with your email code, then your authenticator.
admin__verify_backup_body: Enter one of your backup codes.
admin__verify_body: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
catalog__create_retired: Create as retired (no thumbnail needed yet)
catalog__media_too_large: This file is larger than {{max}} KB.
catalog__media_wrong_type: This file type is not accepted here.
catalog__retire_body: It disappears from the library for new use. History that refers to it still resolves, and you can restore it.
catalog__secondary_invalid: Secondary muscles must not include the primary one.
catalog__thumbnail_hint: JPEG or WebP, up to {{max}} KB. Required for a live exercise.
catalog__type_locked: Sets already use this exercise, so its type is locked.
deletion__app_body: Open Settings, then Profile, then Delete account. Confirm with the link in the email that follows. Everything is removed once you confirm.
deletion__email_body: Write to {{email}} from the address of your account and ask for deletion. The operator deletes the account the same way the app does and confirms by email.
deletion__intro: You can delete your {{app}} account and all of its data at any time, with or without the app installed.
deletion__what_body: Your account, sign-in sessions, Programs, Workouts, Sessions and sets, custom exercises, body metrics, settings and every photo you added.
deletion__what_kept: Database backups that still contain your data expire within 30 days. The record of the operator's actions keeps the account's identifier, never its training data.
download__none: There is no Android build to download yet. Request access on the home page and the invite will bring the link.
invite__live: {{email}} is invited. Install {{app}}, then sign up with this address using an emailed code or Google.
invite__not_live: This invite link no longer works: it was used, withdrawn, or has expired. Ask for a new one from the home page.
legal__draft_note: Draft for review by the operator. It describes what the app does today; it is not yet final.
privacy__collect_account: Your account: your email address, your name, and, if you sign in with Google, the Google account identifier and the address Google confirms. There are no passwords.
privacy__collect_media: Photos you choose to add (progress photos, Session photos, covers and exercise images). They are stored in a private storage bucket and are only shown to you through short-lived links.
privacy__collect_technical: Technical records: the time and device type of sign-ins (to warn you about new ones), the app version you use, IP addresses in short-lived server logs and rate limits, and emails sent to you while they are being delivered.
privacy__collect_training: Your training: Programs, Workouts, Sessions, sets, notes, custom exercises, body weight, body measurements and your settings. It is kept on your device and synced to the server so it survives a lost phone and appears on your other devices.
privacy__intro: {{app}} is a training log. This page says what it stores about you, why, where, and how to remove it. In short: your training data is used to run the app for you and for nothing else.
privacy__keep_body: For as long as you have an account. When you delete your account, its data and photos are removed straight away; database backups that still contain it expire within 30 days.
privacy__rights_body: You can change your name and email address in the app, delete your account at any time, and ask for a copy or a correction of your data by writing to {{email}}.
privacy__site_body: The public pages set no cookies and run no analytics. The request-access form uses Cloudflare Turnstile to keep bots out; Turnstile is loaded only on that form.
privacy__use_admin: The operator can see your account details (address, name, sign-up and sign-in dates, app version, ban state and how many Programs, Sessions, custom exercises and photos you have) to give support or stop abuse. The operator's tools show none of your sets, body metrics, notes or photos. Every change the operator makes to an account is recorded.
privacy__use_body: Only to run the app: to sign you in, sync your data, send sign-in codes and security notices, and keep the service safe from abuse. There is no advertising, no selling of data, no tracking across apps and no analytics.
privacy__where_body: On the operator's server and its database, in a private Cloudflare R2 bucket for photos, and on your devices (encrypted at rest).
privacy__where_processors: Service providers that handle data for the app: Cloudflare (network, storage, and the anti-bot check on forms), the email provider that delivers sign-in codes, Google (only if you sign in with Google) and GitHub (which serves the Android download).
releases__minimum_hint: Builds below this version show a blocking update screen with the download link.
site__pitch: A quiet training log for lifting: plan your Programs, log every set, and see your progress.
site__pitch_detail: Works offline, syncs across your devices, and keeps your data yours. Cinnabar is in a closed beta on Android.
site__request_body: The beta is invite-only. Leave your email address and you will get an invite with the download link when a place opens.
site__request_hint: We only use this address to send your invite. It sets no cookie and is not shared.
site__request_sent: Thanks. If a place opens for this address, an invite with the download link will arrive by email.
site__shot_home: Home: this week's training and the next Workout
site__shot_session: A live Session with the rest timer
support__body: Found a problem in {{app}} or need help with your account? Write to:
support__include: It helps to include the app version (Settings shows it), your phone model and what you were doing.
terms__account_body: You need an invite to create an account. Keep access to your email address safe: it is how you sign in. One person per account.
terms__beta_body: {{app}} is a closed beta. Features may change or disappear, the service may be down at times, and an old build may stop working with the server and ask you to update.
terms__changes_body: If these terms change in a way that matters, you will be told in the app or by email.
terms__content_body: What you log stays yours. You let the operator store and process it only to run the app for you, as the privacy policy describes.
terms__end_body: You can delete your account at any time. The operator may end the beta; if so, you will be told by email beforehand.
terms__health_body: The app records and suggests training numbers; it is not medical or coaching advice. Train within your limits and ask a professional when in doubt.
terms__intro: By using {{app}} you agree to these terms. They are short because the app is simple.
terms__liability_body: The app is provided as it is, free of charge, without warranty. To the extent the law allows, the operator is not liable for lost data or other loss from using it.
terms__use_body: Do not try to break, overload or get around the service's limits, and do not use it to store anything unlawful. The operator may suspend an account that does.
users__admin_protected: This is an admin account; it cannot be banned or deleted here.
users__ban_body: The account is signed out everywhere and cannot sign in or sync until the ban is lifted.
users__delete_body: {{email}} and all of its data and photos are removed for good, as the app's own deletion does. Type the address to confirm.
users__revoke_body: Every session of {{email}} ends. They can sign in again.
